title: Mean-payoff parity games in quasipolynomial time
summary: We give a uniform deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm for mean-payoff parity games. It computes all vertices from which a player can enforce both nonnegative liminf mean payoff and the parity condition, with arbitrary signed binary rewards and unrestricted binary priorities. The running time is $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations, where L is the complete input length.
family_title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games

review.reason: Gives a quasipolynomial-time algorithm for mean-payoff parity games with binary weights.
